name: rmc-time-without-date
reference: spec/engine-spec.md Version 0.10 (the text wire), Locators: 'A pair is absent when either of its fields is absent'. Field 9 is empty, so the pair 1+9 (time_ms) is absent and the sentence decodes; the second line on field 1 (nmea0183.utc_s, hms:2) carries the time of day: 9*3600+45*60+12.5 = 35112.5, written back as 094512.50 (Writing a record, step 1: the pair writes nothing, so the later line's text stands). Derived without an engine.
